mechanism: Modafinil increases dopaminergic activity while tetrabenazine depletes monoamines (dopamine, serotonin, norepinephrine), creating opposing pharmacodynamic effects that may reduce efficacy of tetrabenazine and increase CNS stimulation risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if combination necessary, monitor closely for reduced tetrabenazine efficacy and increased modafinil-related CNS stimulation, agitation, or psychotic symptoms.
